title_o: Scarcity Polarizes Preferences: The Impact on Choice among Multiple Items in a Product Class

replications.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
replications.quote: Results suggested that there was no significant difference between the scarce (M = 2.92, SD = 0.96) and abundant (M = 2.86, SD = 1.04) conditions on the number of different vegetables chosen, ZMann–Whitney = -0.22, p = 0.83.
